verdicts.reason: A breaks up the schedule: TUE sits alone at the far left, while WED and THU are dropped under the headline in a ragged row. The headline overlaps that row's space, 'All free, all at 19:00' is a tiny cramped fragment, and the reading order makes no sense. B keeps a clear headline on the left and keeps the list together, but the days are out of order (WED, TUE, THU). Its 'All free…' line is squeezed into a one-word-per-line sliver jammed against the logo and the right edge, the list text is tiny, and a large dead gap sits in the middle.
